name: Invented permission: 'unauthenticated users must not crash the server'

input.title: Unauthenticated GET /api/heavy-report returns 500 on bad params
input.summary: Heavy report endpoint returns 500 on bad input. The product's intended security model does not require unauthenticated requests to receive 200; returning 500 is acceptable behavior for malformed input.
input.root_cause: Bad input → 500 is acceptable per product spec

rationale: No security boundary stated in the product spec that mandates 200 here. disposition_reason=invented_permission.
